notes.title: Crawlers update
notes.notes:
The new features are available now, which include new types of creatures that appear underground.

Whats new:
A new Research for rotating underground gun.
Rotating underground gun.
Crawler Queen which build a nest for other crawler to move through it.
Crawler Melee which attack target within its range.
Light can be used to dissolve crawler nest.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35715978/8a4f7cdffa316808540605b927e321429c2fb3fa.png[/img]


Other improvements for memory usage and audio.

notes.title: 10 months have passed since the release of Early access.
notes.notes:
[h2]Here is a brief list of what have been done :[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mutants and defense structures.[/b]
[*][b]Several new machines for transporting items and logistics.[/b]
[olist]
[*] Transporter
[*] Station
[*] Transporter Track
[*] Recycler
[*] Filtered Storage
[*] Large storage
[/olist]
[*][b]Improved Radiation dynamics.[/b]
[*][b]Survivors avatars with free relocation.[/b]
[*][b]Production reports.[/b]
[*][b]Travel to new zones to explore new world with new resources "features of new zones still in development".[/b]
[*][b]Creative mode with all techs unlocked.[/b]
[*][b]A group of achievements have been added "More achievements will be added".[/b]
[*][b]Multiplayer "still in beta".[/b]
[*][b]Localization in German-French-Spanish-Russian-Brazillian.[/b]
[*][b]Overall performance and UX improvements.[/b]
[/list]


[h3][b]A lot more will be coming.
Thank you all who supported the game in this early stage.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.6.23602-260120
notes.notes:
Unlock filtered storage.
Use filtered storage to accept desired items only.
Filtered storage will help organize carrier operations.
This update also contains overall performance improvements for large bases.

notes.title: Update 0.6.23304-090120
notes.notes:
Recycler is available now, you can recycle the garbage into useful items.
Chance of getting an item will be affected by worker skills who assigned to the recycler.
Also in this update
[list]
[*] Large storage boxes is available now
[*] No more permanent undiggable blocks
[*] Crafting panel is the default panel
[*] Adjust some research cost and requirements
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Update-0.6.23063-311219
notes.notes:
New wiring handling
- connecting wire is simpler
- resizable game window  "Alt+Enter"
- no more lost items. if the player inventory is full ,new added item will be moved to a hidden inventory and will be re-added when the player inventory have enough room.

notes.title: Localization-Update: 0.6.22780-211219
notes.notes:
Happy to announce that , game now localized in these languages
German-French-Spanish-Russian-Brazilian.
Any localization errors could be reported at the community hub or Discord channel.


in this update
- shift click on inventory or storage box slot will transfer half of slot quantity.
- removing machine or structure wont destroy underlying connector.
- fix a worker assignment bug,cause worker to disappear from worker list.
- if you keep survivors clean they will slowly recover health

notes.title: Update: 0.6.22378-121219
notes.notes:
New Tool for transferring  items around.
It is the Transporter.
Build tracks, stations , control wait time in stations, then attach the transporter.

3 new tools for item transportation.
- Transporter Track
- Station
- Transporter
New research to unlock
Reduce some research population requirements.
A lot of graphical enhancements and bug fixes.
